annotations.title: Dry-run (or run now) a Google Ads automated rule

description: DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: reads the live metrics and returns, object by object, the values it measured and exactly what it WOULD change, with every cap applied — nothing is written. It is the same plan a live run applies, so it cannot describe something a run would not do. dryRun:false applies it now (same gate as switching on), reads the result back and logs it; undo_google_ads_rule_action reverses it. Free.

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend
